verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly publish a data API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only human-facing online search apps, document retrieval, PBS accounts and text/email notices. It documents no API endpoints, no key-issuance path and no rate limits.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
